kids: Make and take a holiday craft
site: Akron Children's Museum, 216 S Main St
about: Hands-On Holidays and Hotcakes is a special event at the Akron Children's Museum in downtown Akron.
It combines a sit down breakfast with a morning of holiday play inside the museum.
Guests check in and head straight to the Holiday Hotcake Hall, a cozy and festive dining space.
The buffet has fluffy pancakes, a toppings bar, coffee and drinks for the whole family.
Once everyone has had time to eat, the special holiday guests announce play time.
That is the cue to head into the museum for make and take holiday crafts, face painting and hands-on STEM activities.
Families also get a meet and greet with Santa and friends.
Session 1 opens its doors at 9:15 AM with the meal at 9:30 AM and play at 10:30 AM.
Session 2 opens at 10:45 AM with the meal then and play at 11:45 AM, and Session 3 opens at noon with play at 1 PM.
Families carry their belongings with them when moving from the dining space to the museum, and the museum closes at 3 PM.
Tickets are sold online through the museum's ticket link.

Yes. A meet and greet with Santa and friends is part of the play time.

Tickets are sold online through the museum's ticket link, and each family picks a session.

Price not listed.

site: Hancock County Fairgrounds, 1017 E Sandusky St
about: Paws and Claus is a themed weekend of Twinkle Nights, the Family Resource Center's drive-thru Christmas light show in Findlay.
Santa Claus is back at Twinkle Nights this year, and he is indoors.
Families can bring the kids, the pets or the whole crew for free photos with Santa.
After the photos, guests enjoy a ride through the lights.
The event runs Saturday, December 19 and Sunday, December 20, each night from 6 to 9 PM.
It takes place at the Hancock County Fairgrounds on East Sandusky Street.
Guests are also invited to bring a wishlist item for the Humane Society and SPCA of Hancock County.
Anyone who brings an item to donate receives a free beverage from Travelin' Tom's Coffee.
Tickets for the drive-thru ride are sold online through the fairs ticketing page.
Twinkle Nights also has other themed nights on its schedule, including a Merry and Bright weekend starting December 25.
